messages:
nina_cs: quick sync: CrossBorder Inc (CB-44) renewal PTO. Procurement just sent a PO but wants a single SOW signed by our UK entity while billing split across their UK and Germany entities. They also want customer-managed KMS and net-60. Finance flagged VAT mismatch on the German VAT number. Need legal + finance to confirm if single-signature SOW + two invoices works.

arjun_re: do we have the raw PO number? can we ask them to attach the VAT registration docs? i'll reach out to procurement now. also curious if CB prefers a single contract for simplicity or if it's a legal req to have per-entity signatures.

kelly_fin: PO: CB-PO-0426-77. finance can't map the German VAT to their legal name in our vendor table. until we have a matching tax id we can't generate the EU invoice. we can draft a split invoice but it'll be pending until verified. also note KMS onboarding will require a separate onboarding acceptance item in SOW.

ben_legal: fyi legal: single SOW signed by Redwood UK is generally fine but the addendum needs to state billing split and indemnities across entities. if they insist on entity-specific liability we may need signatures from both. i can prepare an addendum template. any language prefs?

nina_cs: ask them for scanned VAT cert for DE entity and a confirmation of signing authority. procurement usually replies within 24h but this one is urgent. we have a renewal price lock til EOM, after that they may request discount.

arjun_re: i emailed procurement for VAT cert and a contact. included a sample vendor form to speed mapping. also asked whether finance will accept a PO amendment vs two POs.

kelly_fin: finance can accept PO amendment if procurement confirms amounts per legal entity. prefer separate invoice numbers for reconciliation. setting hold until VAT validated.

ben_legal: drafting addendum now. will include: 1) invoice split clause, 2) KMS onboarding responsibilities (customer provides key ARN + access window), 3) acceptance criteria for enablement, 4) signature block options (one vs two entities). ping when i finish draft.

deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: 'CrossBorder_SOW_v4'. Waiting for attachment: 'Addendum_Invoices_KMS'.

nina_cs: thanks. enablement team note: training window is scheduled week-of-5/2. if billing clearance delays, we can push onboarding by 1 week max. i'll mark risk as 'moderate' in account health and add escalation to AM if VAT docs not received by Thu noon.

arjun_re: procurement replied: attached DE VAT cert and says "German entity will not sign; UK signs for master." they included an internal PO amendment that lists split 60/40 UK/DE. forwarding to finance.

kelly_fin: got the VAT doc. vendor code updated. we can issue UK invoice now; DE invoice pending legal confirmation on liability carveouts. i'll remove hold for UK invoice.

ben_legal: addendum done. language allows master SOW signed by UK with invoice split; includes liability carveout for DE entity and requires CB to indemnify for DE-specific taxes. uploading to DocuSign.

deploy-bot: 'CrossBorder_SOW_v4' envelope updated with 'Addendum_Invoices_KMS' and sent to primary signee.

nina_cs: excellent. once signed i'll submit final PO mapping for AR and schedule enablement. keeping thread open until both invoices clear. :white_check_mark:
